props.stem: A fake delivery notice got you: you clicked its link and typed your password. What do you do first?

options.feedback: Yes: the desk resets your password and closes the session before the attacker uses it. Minutes count; nobody is blamed for calling.

options.text: Change your password, and say nothing
options.feedback: A good reflex, but not enough: the attacker may already be signed in, and others got the same email. Call 4444 so the desk can close the session and block the email for everyone.

options.text: Press Report, then carry on with your day
options.feedback: Report is right before a click. After one, the desk needs to know at once that your password is out: call 4444.

lines.speaker: guide
lines.text: A quick check. Say a fake gets past you. What do you do first?
